inventory.visualPurpose: Immunoglobulin isotypes — the five-isotype roster with structure icons
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: A vector layout of the five isotype entries, each with structure icons drawn as simple Y-unit schematics (IgG monomer; IgA monomer or dimer with J chain; IgM monomer-on-cell or pentamer with J chain, with J-chain labels repeated; IgD monomer; IgE monomer) followed by each isotype's function paragraph.

notes: Census: pure vector page (1x1 artifact only). The five-isotype roster with its structure icons is conveyed in ONE original KYP comparison grid (drawn monomer/dimer/pentamer schematics + five rows of attributes); the verbatim isotype text is the note's table block. FA's printed mnemonic phrases are not reproduced in user-facing content.
